notes: Correction: the supplied it were moved from ὡς to the predicate noun ὀθόνην. The accepted reading gave a supplied subject pronoun and copula to a comparative particle, which no rule licenses; rules 53, 63, 68 and 96 place them on the standing predicate, and rule 15 permits the discontinuity around great. Treating as it were as one frozen English idiom on ὡς remains defensible and is named in the unit note.
ἐν πόλει Ἰόππῃ split into city and of Joppa rather than treated as one name phrase (rule 26).
τέσσαρσιν ἀρχαῖς split, the case preposition by riding with the determinerless noun under rule 21.
a certain kept whole on τι; the rule 58 alternative giving the a to σκεῦος is named in that unit's note.
